lessons.title: Why MLPs Struggle with Images
lessons.description: Understand the parameter explosion of flattening 2D/3D images into 1D vectors and the need for spatial invariance.

lessons.title: Convolutions, Kernels, & Feature Maps
lessons.description: Discover how 2D convolution filters slide across pixels to detect edges, corners, and texture gradients.

lessons.title: Pooling & Hierarchical Feature Learning
lessons.description: Downsample feature maps using Max and Average Pooling, and observe how deep layers build abstractions from lines to faces.

lessons.title: Landmark CNNs & Transfer Learning
lessons.description: Explore pivotal architectures like AlexNet, VGG, and ResNet's residual skip connections, and apply transfer learning.
